notes: 英文是在遊戲外執行模組註冊文字的程式記錄下來的；模組另外內建西班牙文，那部分不收錄。
ACHIEVEMENT_ 開頭的是解鎖造型的成就。
MIRROR_ 開頭的條目與 DOME_ENTER 是靠近冰鏡或冰鏡穹頂時畫面上的互動提示。
魔鏡冰晶（X）熟練度的提示，以及 Kizuna 羈絆模組（Zerneas-KizunaMod）的大廳、標題畫面、技能清單與羈絆說明，文字寫死在程式裡（只有英文和西班牙文），不經過語言表，翻不到。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_DESCRIPTION.en:
Haku fights from afar and from his ice mirrors: set them, go into them, strike out of all of them at once.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Every hit of your skills leaves an ice needle round you; the Sensatsu Suisho lets them all go.

< ! > Set mirrors with your utility, then press Interact by one to go into it: from inside, every attack comes out of every mirror, and your utility passes you to another.

< ! > With 3 mirrors near, X raises the dome of ice mirrors round your target. Strike its mirrors, or go into it and dance.

< ! > Chakra control: hold Jump against a wall to run on it.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
白在遠處與他的冰鏡之中作戰：架起冰鏡、進入冰鏡，再從所有冰鏡同時出擊。<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! >技能每命中一次，就會在你身邊留下一根冰針；千殺水翔會將它們全數射出。

< ! >用輔助技能架起冰鏡，再到冰鏡旁按互動鍵進入：在冰鏡裡時，每次攻擊都會從每一面冰鏡射出，輔助技能則會帶你移到另一面冰鏡。

< ! >附近有3面冰鏡時，按X鍵會在目標周圍升起冰鏡穹頂。攻擊穹頂的冰鏡，或進入穹頂起舞。

< ! >查克拉控制：貼著牆按住跳躍鍵就能在牆上奔跑。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_LORE.en: The last of a clan hunted for its ice. Taken in by Zabuza, Haku became his weapon, and asked for nothing but to be of use to him.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_LORE.zh-TW: 因冰遁而遭到追殺的一族最後的倖存者。被再不斬收留後，白成了他的武器，除了能對他有用之外，別無所求。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_OUTRO_FLAVOR.en: ..and so Haku left, a tool that had found its own reason.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_OUTRO_FLAVOR.zh-TW: ……於是白離開了，這件工具找到了屬於自己的理由。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_OUTRO_FAILURE.en: ..and so Haku fell, like snow that never reaches spring.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_OUTRO_FAILURE.zh-TW: ……於是白倒下了，宛如等不到春天的雪。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: Every hit of your skills leaves an <style=cIsDamage>ice needle</style> round you (8s each, no limit; your senbon, one a throw; your mirrors, one a volley). Standing still, they don't melt. Your hits <style=cIsUtility>chill</style>: -25% speed.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 技能每命中一次，就會在你身邊留下一根<style=cIsDamage>冰針</style>（每根持續8秒，沒有上限；千本每次投擲留下一根，冰鏡每輪齊射留下一根）。保持靜止時冰針不會融化。你的攻擊會使敵人<style=cIsUtility>受寒</style>：移動速度-25%。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_PRIMARY_SENBON_DESCRIPTION.en: Throw 3 senbon for <style=cIsDamage>52%</style> each. From inside a mirror: every mirror throws 3 x <style=cIsDamage>40%</style> at the enemy nearest it. In the air, looking down: a <style=cIsDamage>dive kick</style>, <style=cIsDamage>330%</style> in 5m where you land.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_PRIMARY_SENBON_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 投擲3根千本，每根造成<style=cIsDamage>52%</style>傷害。在冰鏡裡時：每面冰鏡都會朝離它最近的敵人投擲3根，每根造成<style=cIsDamage>40%</style>傷害。在空中朝下看時改為<style=cIsDamage>俯衝踢</style>：在落地處半徑5米內造成<style=cIsDamage>330%</style>傷害。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_SECONDARY_SENSATSU_DESCRIPT.en: A sphere of water needles closes on your target: <style=cIsDamage>400%</style> in 6m. Lets go every ice needle into it, <style=cIsDamage>+50%</style> each, and takes 1s off your other cooldowns.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_SECONDARY_SENSATSU_DESCRIPT.zh-TW: 水針聚成的球體朝目標合攏：在半徑6米內造成<style=cIsDamage>400%</style>傷害。同時把所有冰針射向目標，每根<style=cIsDamage>+50%</style>，並使你其他技能的冷卻時間減少1秒。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_UTILITY_MIRROR_DESCRIPTION.en: Set an ice mirror where you aim. Up to 6: a new one bursts the oldest (<style=cIsDamage>150%</style>). <style=cIsUtility>Interact</style> by one to go into it: <style=cIsUtility>untouchable</style> for up to 6s; this key passes you to the mirror you aim at. 3 charges.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_UTILITY_MIRROR_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 在瞄準處架起一面冰鏡。最多6面：架起新冰鏡時，最舊的那面會碎裂爆開（<style=cIsDamage>150%</style>）。在冰鏡旁<style=cIsUtility>互動</style>即可進入：最多6秒內<style=cIsUtility>不會受到攻擊</style>；在冰鏡裡按這個鍵會移到你瞄準的冰鏡。3次充能。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_SPECIAL_TSUBAME_DESCRIPTION.en: 8 swallows of ice hunt the enemy at your crosshair, each bursting for <style=cIsDamage>250%</style> damage in an area.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_SPECIAL_TSUBAME_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 8隻冰燕追擊準星對準的敵人，每隻爆開時對範圍造成<style=cIsDamage>250%</style>傷害。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_DOME_DESCRIPTION.en: Needs 3 of your mirrors near (each extra: +1s, +10%). A dome of ice mirrors traps your target and what's round it for 8s. Strike a mirror: the attack comes out of all of them. <style=cIsUtility>Interact</style> by one: you dance through every mirror, striking. It bursts inward at its end.
ZERNEAS_HAKU_DOME_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 附近需要有3面你的冰鏡（每多一面：+1秒、+10%）。冰鏡穹頂會困住目標與它周圍的敵人8秒。攻擊其中一面冰鏡：這次攻擊會從所有冰鏡射出。在冰鏡旁<style=cIsUtility>互動</style>：你會在每一面冰鏡之間穿梭攻擊。穹頂結束時會向內爆裂。

ZERNEAS_HAKU_MIRROR_AIM.en: Aim at another mirror to pass to it
ZERNEAS_HAKU_MIRROR_AIM.zh-TW: 瞄準另一面冰鏡即可移過去

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASHAKUCLEARGAMEMONSOON_.en: As Haku, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASHAKUCLEARGAMEMONSOON_.zh-TW: 作為白，在季風難度下通關遊戲或抹除自己。

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASHAKUCLEARMERIDIANEVEN.en: As Haku, defeat the False Son.
